offence_note: Uttering threats and criminal harassment of former partner
sentence_quote: On the criminal harassment charge, Count 7, that is time served. On the charge of threatening AB, that is Count 6, the sentenced is six months' imprisonment. Those sentences are concurrent.
note: Time served about 505 days; threats count six months concurrent.

offence_note: Loaded prohibited firearm, careless handling, fail to remain, refuse breath
sentence_quote: The respondent shall continue to serve the remainder of his conditional sentence as imposed.
note: Court held three years was fit but declined reincarceration; appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Manslaughter and assault arising from Skytrain station attack
sentence_quote: For Count 1, the offence of manslaughter, I sentence you to six months less one day of imprisonment, and probation for three years.
note: Assault count three months concurrent; co-participant sentenced separately.

offence_note: Possession of marihuana for trafficking and production
sentence_quote: I sentenced the Offender to two and one-half years of incarceration or imprisonment, and issued orders imposing the firearms prohibition and the forfeiture of the property.

offence_note: Robbery with imitation firearm, use of imitation firearm, breach of release order
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal from sentence, and vary the sentence for Count 3 by reducing it to an 8-month sentence, consecutive to the sentence for Count 1.
note: 23 months on Count 1 plus 8 months consecutive on Count 3; 90 days concurrent on Count 4.

offence_note: First degree murder, discharging and possessing prohibited firearm
sentence_quote: Mr. Reed, on Count 1, first-degree murder, I sentence you to life in prison with no eligibility for parole for 25 years.
systemic_quote: Counsel also submits that some of Mr. Reed's poor decisions in the past have been reactive to incidents of racism and bigotry directed towards him. I accept that submission.
note: Firearm counts 6 and 4 years concurrent; co-accused not sentenced in this decision.

offence_note: GST refund fraud against Revenue Canada
sentence_quote: The appeal is allowed in part. There will be no reduction in the length of imprisonment. However, the fine will be reduced to $358,761.38.
note: Fine reduced from $717,522.75 to statutory minimum; jail term unchanged.

offence_note: Home invasion robbery, break and enter, death threat, theft under
sentence_quote: we are of the view that a further period of imprisonment of 8 months is appropriate.
note: Conditional sentence replaced by jail; further 8 months after pre-trial custody and 5 months of CSO served.

offence_note: Tractor trailer thefts and robberies using real or imitation firearm
sentence_quote: we grant leave to appeal sentence, allow the appeal, and reduce the sentence to six and one-half years (prior to the credit for pre-sentence custody).
note: Reduced from 8.5 years on parity and fresh evidence; co-accused sentences reduced earlier.
